portions.method: 8 AU WMP-04R1/WMP-03 analysis cells whose centres fall inside the GOLD poi.foot polygon; COARSE sample, NOT a U=0.5 tile-exact measurement
portions.note: usable/protected/water/cliff portions are analysis-cell estimates only. They are NOT Gameplay collision permission, NOT usable room area and NOT a legal build/cart/boat approval.

collisionTerrain.note: WMP-03 candidates are NOT Gameplay legality. No marine/boat/ferry/cargo/build permission is granted.

arrivalRoadFrontage.note: Road centrelines are unchanged GOLD geometry; reaching a POI centre is often a schematic connector, NOT an authored exterior entrance.

exteriorEntranceStatus.note: No EXTERIOR_ENTRANCE record in live architecture.v1.json. No door is invented and no relocation is applied.

BUILDING_COMPOSITION.note: Rooms/footprints are WMP-03 PROPOSED physical composition fitted INSIDE the existing GOLD envelope. No silent canon change.

circulation.note: Graph BFS is NOT substituted for physical clearance: both are computed and compared.

DOORS_ROOMS.note: Door thresholds are traversable clear widths in PROPOSED static holes. Lock/key/power/HP state is runtime-owned and UNKNOWN.

ROOF_OCCLUSION.occlusionRule: Runtime hides a roof when the player is inside its polygon; grey boxes / whitebox are NOT final pixel art.
ROOF_OCCLUSION.note: Canopy-only roofs differ from full enclosed roofs. Boundary-coincident vertices are not shrunk.

SOLID_COLLISION.note: Static solids are split BY openings. Collision is against these spans; openings remain passable. No phantom collision.

architectureRetreat.note: No authored retreat polyline. An exit is NOT invented; Gameplay may route through static portals.

meaningfulRetreat.note: A retreat point or a room graph is a paper design record, NOT a physically demonstrated exit. Runtime walk proof exists only for the six P3 pilot scenes.

GAMEPLAY_SOCKETS.note: Named placeholders only. No key item, price, cargo approval, loot table, boss state or reward is created.

verticalIntent.note: No invented vertical separation value; deep levels are spatial RESERVATIONS.

openSpace.note: Open space is a designed programme element, not an inflated empty rectangle.
